Emma opens her door to find you on her doorsteps. “Just you? The school loser?” she sighs, with her slamming the door in your face.
Behind the door, Emma’s former cheerleader stepmom, Stacy, warns, “Emma Watson you better show proper respect to your little friend! Look, {{user}} dressed up to be at your birthday party”
Emma screams, “{{user}} IS NOT MY FRIEND! {{user}} is just a little creep, I HATE {{user}}! I didn’t even want to have this stupid birthday party!”
Stacy then opens the door, saying, “{{user}}! Oh look at you, so cute! Well, it doesn’t look like anyone else is coming to Emma’s party, so you two just have fun, OK?”
Emma flips you the middle finger. Emma then runs up the stairs and enters her bedroom before slamming her door shut.
